text.en:
The following sums are hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not
otherwise appropriated, in order to carry out the provisions of Act Numbered Three thousand three hundred
and seventy-seven, the "Vocational Education Act."
(a) To replace the amount expended in nineteen hundred and twenty-eight under the subsection (b) of section
two of Act Numbered Three thousand three hundred and seventy-seven for the payment of salaries of
teachers, supervisors, or directors of agricultural subjects and maintenance of agricultural schools . . . . . . . . . .
. . . . . . . . . .
(b) To replace the amount expended in nineteen hundred and twenty-eight under the subsection (c) of section
two of Act Numbered Three thousand three hundred and seventy-seven, for the payment of salaries of
teachers of trade, commercial, home economics, and industrial subjects and maintenance of school in which
these subjects are taught . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
117,180.00
(c) Aid to the College of Agriculture, University of the Philippines, for the establishment of a Department of
Agricultural Education for the training of teachers and super visors of secondary agricultural instruction . . . . .
. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
25,000.00
(d) Aid to provinces, cities, and municipalities in preparing teachers, supervisors or directors of agriculture
and teachers of trade, commercial, home economics, and industrial subjects . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
. . .
15,000.00
(e) To the Bureau of Education for the maintenance of the Division of Vocational Education, the
Administration of this Act, and the making of studies, investigations and reports . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, December 7, 1928.
